scope: All declared cases; no checkpoint selection. CPU replay discrepancies retained for compiled follow-up. Timeouts are unfinished.
full_state_scope: Initial model, complete optimizer, sampler and counters compared bitwise with each frozen source; only inspection timing excluded.
replay_scope: All saved endpoints replayed on CPU; every discrepant endpoint also replayed using original compiled CUDA. Original3e-4 absolute/relative loss tolerance and exact counts retained. Saving training queries after evaluation can add an FP32 mode-roundtrip difference; this is not isolated as the sole cause.
